content: To reduce your risk of developing kidney and renal pelvis cancers, it is important to maintain a healthy body weight, avoid smoking or quit if you currently smoke, and exercise caution when working with the chemical trichloroethylene. Kidney and renal pelvis cancer is a condition characterized by the uncontrolled growth of cells within the kidney. The most common type of this cancer is renal cell carcinoma. The human body has two kidneys, located on either side of the body behind the liver and stomach. The kidneys are responsible for producing urine, which helps the body eliminate liquid waste. Additionally, the kidneys regulate blood pressure and stimulate the bone marrow to produce red blood cells. The renal pelvis is a central structure within the kidney that collects urine and channels it into the ureters. The ureters are two tubes that connect the kidneys to the bladder, where urine is stored until it is excreted from the body. Symptoms of kidney or renal pelvis cancer may include blood in the urine, a lump or swelling in the kidney or abdominal area, persistent lower back or side pain, fatigue, recurrent fever, loss of appetite, unexplained weight loss, bowel obstruction, or a general feeling of poor health. It is important to note that these symptoms can also be caused by other conditions, so consulting a doctor is essential if any of these symptoms occur. Several factors can increase the risk of developing kidney and renal pelvis cancers. These include being overweight or obese, smoking, having high blood pressure (though it is unclear whether the risk is due to the condition itself or the medications used to treat it), prolonged use of certain pain medications, specific genetic conditions, chronic hepatitis C infection, kidney stones, sickle cell trait (which is linked to a rare form of kidney cancer called renal medullary carcinoma), and exposure to trichloroethylene, a chemical used to degrease metals. To lower the risk of kidney and renal pelvis cancers, individuals should avoid smoking, maintain a healthy weight, consume a nutritious diet, engage in regular physical activity, and exercise caution when handling chemicals like trichloroethylene, particularly in occupational settings. The United States Cancer Statistics Data Visualizations tool provides access to the latest federal cancer data. This tool allows users to explore statistics on new cases and deaths related to kidney and renal pelvis cancers across the United States and by individual states. It also provides insights into cancer rates by age, sex, race, and ethnicity, as well as trends over time.
